mechanism.claim: At fixed eight-hour boundaries, a large BTC move in an already elevated implied-volatility regime is less durable when BVOL and DVOL disagree unusually in their levels relative to their own causal medians; the move represents an incompletely confirmed shock and should be faded for six hours.
mechanism.side: opposite sign of the completed eight-hour BTC return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVCFF uses cross-venue volatility levels normalized to their own historical medians at a fixed eight-hour clock. Prior disagreement candidates used opposing hourly bodies, lead/deceleration, or intrahour absorption; HVCFF uses none of those and is not a threshold/hold repair.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: three fixed decisions per day plus cross-venue implied-volatility level fracture are absent from Gross9

clock.decision: exact UTC 00:00/08:00/16:00 boundary D after eight consecutive completed valid price hours
clock.volatility_levels: BVOL close and DVOL close at D each >= own strict-prior 720h q60 with 672 observations
clock.normalized_fracture: absolute log((BVOL/prior720h median)/(DVOL/prior720h median)) >= strict-prior 270-block q60 with 252 observations
clock.price_shock: nonzero absolute BTC return over [D-8h,D) >= strict-prior 270-block q60 with 252 observations
clock.reservation: fixed blocks are nonoverlapping; global half-open, exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only for later PnL

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.volatility: reuse hash-bound OCDR-12C BVOL/DVOL snapshot through 2026-08-01
source_plan.completed_price_path: reuse hash-bound OLIAH completed-hour snapshot through 2026-08-01
source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source-support and Gross9 novelty pass
